title: Verify: Execution, approve and retry routes are absent and admin table is round-only unit tests
summary: Unit tests prove removed routes are unreachable
description: Add tests in server_test.go using New with a temp-dir config and the shared adminRoundRoutes table; no real server or network.
acceptance_criteria: Execution/approve/retry paths with the admin token return 404 or 405
adminRoundRoutes has exactly five round routes
technical_constraints: httptest recorder only; t.TempDir for repo

steps.action: Build the handler as TestNew_AdminRoundsAreMounted does (same config helper, t.TempDir repo, admin token). For each of GET /api/v1/admin/executions, POST /api/v1/admin/executions/x/approve, POST /api/v1/admin/executions/x/retry, send the request with Authorization Bearer admin token via httptest.NewRecorder and assert the code is 404 or 405
steps.code: for _, c := range []struct{m,p string}{{"GET","/api/v1/admin/executions"},{"POST","/api/v1/admin/executions/x/approve"},{"POST","/api/v1/admin/executions/x/retry"}} { ... if rec.Code != 404 && rec.Code != 405 { t.Fatalf(...) } }

steps.action: Assert len(adminRoundRoutes(&admin.RoundHandler{})) == 5 and that no Pattern contains the substring "execution"
steps.code: if len(rts) != 5 { t.Fatalf("want 5 routes, got %d", len(rts)) }
steps.expected: Test passes with five routes and no execution pattern
